principle: Continuous passive sensing is automatic; events are never spawned to keep the watch interesting.
runtime_rule: Ship Runtime maintains passive short- and long-range surveillance continuously in simulated time. World State changes first; Sensor Core evaluates detectability; Routine Watch compares observations with baseline; only meaningful deltas create alerts. The UI is a client, not the owner of surveillance.

identified.rule: A detectable contact with a recognized transponder or sufficient deterministic correlation is incorporated automatically with available factual data.

unknown.rule: A detectable contact without sufficient identification is incorporated as unknown/unidentified and highlighted for officer attention.

contact_acquisition.prohibition: The Computer may not invent identity, affiliation, intent or hidden cause.

contact_loss_policy.anomalous_rule: A previously stable contact with sufficient confidence that disappears suddenly without a known sensor explanation raises an immediate anomalous-contact-loss alert.

offscreen_rule.requirement: When the player is not at the Sensor console, ship surveillance still belongs to the ship runtime.
offscreen_rule.catch_up: On resume, Core resolves elapsed World State and reconstructs sensor-observable changes before presenting alerts.
offscreen_rule.prototype_note: The current web Holodeck approximates this with a periodic local cycle while open.
